title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Can SMILES be fragmented into a concatenable ordered sequence of retrosynthetically interesting string block ?
items.abstract_or_text: Molecules generated by deep learning models are often difficult to synthesize. Their synthetic accessibility can be improved with automated retrosynthetic analysis, which allows for identifying synthons. However, synthons in a SMILES can be scattered throughout the string depending on the path taken through the molecular graph used to generate the SMILES. We tested whether the ensemble of possible SMILES for a molecule can be used to generate a concatenable ordered sequence of string fragments (blocks) from SMILES that match potential synthons obtained through automated retrosynthetic analysis. We found that exhaustively sampling the SMILES space of a molecule improves the coverage of retrosynthetic breaks. We achieved full coverage of retrosynthetic bonds in string form for 85\% of the 1.9 million molecules in the MOSES dataset. Doing so allowed us to test our block SMILES in an unconditional de novo drug design test case with MolGPT and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). We found that using blocks as an LLM's token did degrade MolGPT performance due to the curse of dimensionality. However, using the SMILES selected by our blocking algorithm with the default SMILES tokenizer improved the reproduction of physico-chemical properties of samples and also improved uniqueness, novelty, and validity. The MCTS outperforms our MolGPT models in terms of validity and novelty. However, samples generated by the MCTS had physico-chemical properties that were further away from the MOSES baseline than the samples produced by molGPT, with an improved distribution of quantitative estimation of drug-likeness (QED).
items.summary_zh: 该研究通过枚举同一分子的 SMILES 表示，将与自动逆合成分析得到的潜在合成子相对应的字符串片段组织为可拼接、有序的区块，并在 MolGPT 与 Monte Carlo Tree Search（MCTS）生成中测试其作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把逆合成断键显式引入分子字符串表示，为合成可及性导向的生成设计提供了具体路径；但区块作为 LLM token 会受维度灾难影响而降低 MolGPT 表现，且结果仍限于 MOSES 基准与计算评测，尚无实验合成验证。
items.abstract_zh: 深度学习模型生成的分子往往难以合成。通过自动逆合成分析可以识别合成子，从而改善其合成可及性。然而，取决于生成 SMILES 时遍历分子图的路径，SMILES 中的合成子可能分散在字符串各处。我们测试了能否利用一个分子的全部可能 SMILES，生成由与自动逆合成分析所得潜在合成子相匹配的 SMILES 字符串片段（区块）构成、可拼接且有序的序列。我们发现，对一个分子的 SMILES 空间进行穷尽采样可提高逆合成断键的覆盖率。对于 MOSES 数据集中的 190 万个分子，有 85% 的分子实现了以字符串形式对逆合成键的完全覆盖。由此，我们得以在一个使用 MolGPT 和 Monte Carlo Tree Search（MCTS）的无条件 de novo 药物设计测试案例中检验区块 SMILES。我们发现，将区块用作 LLM 的 token 会因维度灾难而降低 MolGPT 的表现。然而，使用阻断算法选出的 SMILES 并采用默认 SMILES tokenizer，可改善样本理化性质的再现性，也提高了唯一性、新颖性和有效性。MCTS 在有效性和新颖性方面优于我们的 MolGPT 模型。然而，MCTS 生成样本的理化性质与 MOSES 基线相距更远，而其类药性定量估计（QED）的分布有所改善。
items.author_line: Reboul, E., Prabakaran, H., Waldispuhl, J., Taly, A.

items.title: Bridging Food Chemistry and Computational Approaches with Agentic AI: Plant Protein Solubility and Bioactive-Enzyme Interactions
items.abstract_or_text: Computational approaches can provide valuable molecular-level and data-driven insights for food chemistry research, but their broader use remains limited by the need for specialized computational and programming expertise. In this study, we propose a human–AI collaborative framework that bridges food chemistry and computational approaches through simple, visible, step-by-step agentic AI workflow design. The framework enables food scientists to translate domain-specific hypotheses into computational workflows that can be planned, implemented, tested, refined, and reused with AI assistance. Two practical applications are presented. The first uses surface-based structural descriptors to investigate plant protein water solubility. Principal component analysis explained 94.19% of the total variance in the first two components and distinguished proteins with greater surface exposure of charged residues from those enriched in surface-exposed Asn/Gln or nonpolar residues, which may favor protein–protein interactions and lower water solubility. The second integrates AlphaFold 3-based structural prediction and MM/GBSA binding affinity estimation to investigate interactions between food-derived polyphenols and pancreatic lipase. The predicted binding-affinity ranking of quercetin > curcumin > resveratrol was consistent with reported enzymatic inhibition trends, while residue-level analysis suggested that hydrophobic contacts and interactions with catalytic residues, particularly Ser153, contribute to ligand stabilization near the catalytic region. Together, these examples demonstrate how food chemistry hypotheses can be translated into clear, traceable, and reusable agentic AI workflows, lowering technical barriers to computational food chemistry while supporting both task execution and computational learning.
items.summary_zh: 该工作提出可见、逐步的人机协作 Agentic AI 工作流，将食品化学假设转为可规划、实施、测试和复用的计算流程，并以植物蛋白溶解性和膳食多酚—胰脂肪酶相互作用为例验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把结构描述符、AlphaFold 3 与 MM/GBSA 整合为可追溯的食品化学计算范式，降低了领域研究者采用计算方法的门槛；但配体排序主要与既有抑制趋势一致，结合预测和工作流的可迁移性仍需独立实验与更多体系检验。
items.abstract_zh: 计算方法能够为食品化学研究提供有价值的分子层面和数据驱动见解，但其更广泛的应用仍受到需要专门计算和编程技能的限制。在本研究中，我们提出了一个人机协作框架，通过简单、可见、逐步的 Agentic AI 工作流设计，将食品化学与计算方法连接起来。该框架使食品科学家能够在 AI 协助下，将领域特异性假设转化为可规划、实施、测试、完善和复用的计算工作流。文中展示了两个实际应用。第一个应用利用基于表面的结构描述符研究植物蛋白的水溶性。主成分分析在前两个主成分中解释了总方差的 94.19%，并区分出表面暴露带电残基更多的蛋白，与表面暴露 Asn/Gln 或非极性残基富集、可能有利于蛋白—蛋白相互作用并降低水溶性的蛋白。第二个应用整合基于 AlphaFold 3 的结构预测与 MM/GBSA 结合亲和力估计，研究食品来源多酚与胰脂肪酶的相互作用。预测的结合亲和力排序 quercetin > curcumin > resveratrol 与已报道的酶抑制趋势一致，而残基层面的分析表明，疏水接触以及与催化残基、尤其是 Ser153 的相互作用，有助于在催化区域附近稳定配体。总体而言，这些实例展示了如何将食品化学假设转化为清晰、可追溯且可复用的 Agentic AI 工作流，在支持任务执行和计算学习的同时降低计算食品化学的技术门槛。
items.author_line: Xiping Gong, Yike Zhao, Madelyn M. Rippo, Hualu Zhou

items.title: Four numbers, one axis: deep learning models reveal what leaf spectrum constrains about Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry photosynthesis
items.abstract_or_text: Leaf reflectance spectra are emerging as a viable substitute for gas-exchange measurements of photosynthetic capacity, with a community benchmark reporting that a spectrum accurately recovers most Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry (FvCB) parameters. This study re-scores the recovery under dataset-blocked, species-blocked, and leave-one-dataset-out designs, measuring the split-half reliability of each curated parameter. We constructed a convolutional encoder that maps a spectrum to the four parameters through a fixed, differentiable FvCB decoder trained on measured assimilation. A conspecific of 97.4% of held-out leaves were present in the training set, and accuracy is lost along the dataset axis but not along the species axis. Under blocked evaluation, a spectrum constrains a single capacity axis. Jmax25 retains only 17% of its recovery when Vcmax25 is held constant, and the Jmax25:Vcmax25 ratio is not predicted above a median null. The curated values of TPU25 are not reproducible, whereas those of Rday25 are well determined, but its recovery fails due to the loss. The published study measures interpolation rather than transfer, and spectra constrain less of the FvCB parameter space than assumed, including the carboxylation to electron transport balance. Routing predictions through explicit biochemistry makes identifiability measurable, although it does not improve prediction accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 研究以数据集阻断、物种阻断和留一数据集验证重新评估叶片反射光谱预测 FvCB 光合参数的能力，并利用带固定可微 FvCB 解码器的卷积编码器考察参数可辨识性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作以更严格的外推验证纠正了光谱可恢复多个光合参数的乐观结论，并将预测接入显式生物化学模型；但研究也表明光谱主要约束单一能力轴，跨数据集泛化与 Jmax25:Vcmax25 等参数的识别能力有限。
items.abstract_zh: 叶片反射光谱正成为气体交换测量光合能力的一种可行替代方法，一项社区基准研究报告称，一个光谱能够准确恢复大多数 Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry（FvCB）参数。本研究在数据集阻断、物种阻断和留一数据集设计下重新评估这种恢复能力，并测量每个整理参数的半样本可靠性。我们构建了一个卷积编码器，通过在测得同化数据上训练的固定、可微 FvCB 解码器，将光谱映射至四个参数。在留出的叶片中，有 97.4% 的同种叶片存在于训练集中；准确性沿数据集轴下降，但不沿物种轴下降。在阻断评估下，一个光谱只约束单一能力轴。当 Vcmax25 保持恒定时，Jmax25 仅保留其恢复能力的 17%，且 Jmax25:Vcmax25 比值的预测不高于中位数空模型。整理后的 TPU25 数值不可重复，而 Rday25 数值确定性较高，但由于损失其恢复失败。已发表研究测量的是插值而非迁移，光谱对 FvCB 参数空间的约束程度低于既有假设，其中包括羧化与电子传递之间的平衡。通过显式生物化学传递预测使可辨识性可被测量，尽管这并不提高预测准确性。
items.author_line: Ray, R., Maloof, J., Magney, T.

items.title: A pretrained unified model enables cellular functional profile prediction and multi-objective virtual drug screening
items.abstract_or_text: Cells are characterized by molecular states, coordinated molecular interactions, regulatory programs, and responses to perturbations. Systematic mapping of these cellular functional profiles across biological contexts remains experimentally costly and fragmented. Here we present InsilicoCell, a pretrained multi-modal, multi-task model that unifies prediction of cellular functional profiles spanning molecular states, molecular interactions, and perturbation-induced responses. Built on a supervised transformer architecture and pretrained on more than 88 million measurements across seven tasks, including drug sensitivity, drug-induced gene expression, and drug-protein binding, InsilicoCell learns a shared representation that links molecular profiles to cellular phenotypes, improves performance over task-specific models, and generalizes to unseen entities, contexts, and conditions. InsilicoCell extends beyond cell line systems to patient, spatial and single-cell settings, and enables multi-objective virtual drug screening. It identifies novel candidate compounds with experimental validation, including c-Myc activity inhibitors, antifibrotic agents and stemness-inducing compounds. Together, InsilicoCell provides a scalable framework for predictive cellular biology and therapeutic discovery.
items.summary_zh: InsilicoCell 是一个在超过 8800 万条、覆盖七类任务测量上预训练的多模态多任务 Transformer，可联合预测细胞分子状态、相互作用与扰动响应，并据此开展多目标虚拟药物筛选和候选化合物实验验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 统一表征将药物敏感性、药物诱导基因表达和药物—蛋白结合连接到细胞表型，可扩展至患者、空间和单细胞场景，并已有 c-Myc 抑制剂、抗纤维化及促干性候选的实验线索；但其跨场景泛化和命中物的机制、选择性与成药性仍须在预印本之外独立复核。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞由分子状态、协调的分子相互作用、调控程序以及对扰动的响应所表征。跨生物学背景系统绘制这些细胞功能谱在实验上仍然成本高昂且较为碎片化。我们在此提出 InsilicoCell，这是一个预训练的多模态、多任务模型，统一预测涵盖分子状态、分子相互作用和扰动诱导响应的细胞功能谱。InsilicoCell 基于监督式 Transformer 架构构建，并在七类任务的超过 8800 万条测量数据上预训练，其中包括药物敏感性、药物诱导基因表达和药物—蛋白结合。它学习一种将分子谱与细胞表型相连接的共享表征，相较任务特异性模型提升性能，并可泛化至未见实体、背景和条件。InsilicoCell 超越细胞系系统，扩展至患者、空间和单细胞场景，并支持多目标虚拟药物筛选。它识别出具有实验验证的新候选化合物，包括 c-Myc 活性抑制剂、抗纤维化药物和诱导干性的化合物。总体而言，InsilicoCell 为预测性细胞生物学和治疗发现提供了一个可扩展框架。
items.author_line: Chen, R., Huang, L., Qiao, Y., Mandal, S., Mo, L., Li, L., Leshchiner, D., Zhang, X., Pu, J., Xie, Y., Girgis, R., Ellsworth, E., Huang, L., Chen, X., Li, X., Zhou, J., Chen, B.

items.title: Synthesis and Optimization of a Nanoparticle Vaccine to Deliver Tumor-Associated Glycopeptide Immunogens Against Pancreatic Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: β-glucans are polymers of glucose, primarily with a 1,3- “beta” linkage at the anomeric center connection points. They are found in various forms in fungi, bacteria and cereals, and are known for their immune stimulant activity as well as being a source of essential fiber in the human diet. These polysaccharides have been employed in many experimental immunotherapeutic modalities as targeting agents to the protein Dectin-1 on Antigen Presenting Cells (APCs). We have previously synthesized gold nanoparticle coated with yeast β-glucans and functionalized with glycopeptide antigens from tumor-associated Mucin-4, a potential biomarker for pancreatic cancer, as a possible vaccine candidate against Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinomas (PDACs). In this report, we have refined this design to include β-glucans from different sources, designed a novel attachment point to covalently link antigen to the polysaccharide backbone and evaluated the cytokine response to treatment of RAW264.7 tumor macrophages with these new nanoparticles and found them to elicit an inflammatory antitumor response through the gene expression of TNF-a and IL-6. We also included a built-in cleavage site for protease release of antigen after endocytosis of these particles into an APCs. Future administration of these constructs into animals should provide a new and selective way of delivering tumor neoantigens to the immune system as a therapeutic vaccine against not only PDACs, but any cancer where glycopeptides from highly overexpressed tumor-associated surface proteins can be processed by adaptive immune surveillance.
items.summary_zh: 该研究优化了以不同来源 β-glucan 包覆的金纳米颗粒—Mucin-4 糖肽抗原疫苗，设计共价连接位点和内吞后蛋白酶切割释放位点，并在 RAW264.7 肿瘤巨噬细胞中检测炎症性抗肿瘤细胞因子反应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作展示了多糖靶向、糖肽抗原呈递和可切割释放设计在胰腺癌治疗性疫苗中的组合，并提供 TNF-a 与 IL-6 基因表达证据；但目前仅为体外巨噬细胞结果，动物免疫原性、抗肿瘤功效及安全性尚待验证。
items.abstract_zh: β-glucans 是葡萄糖聚合物，主要在异头中心连接点具有 1,3-“beta” 键。它们以多种形式存在于真菌、细菌和谷物中，因其免疫刺激活性以及作为必需膳食纤维来源而为人所知。这些多糖已在多种实验性免疫治疗模式中被用作靶向 Antigen Presenting Cells（APCs）上蛋白 Dectin-1 的试剂。我们此前已合成用酵母 β-glucans 包覆的金纳米颗粒，并以肿瘤相关 Mucin-4 的糖肽抗原进行功能化；Mucin-4 是胰腺癌的潜在生物标志物，这些颗粒可作为抗胰腺导管腺癌（PDACs）的候选疫苗。在本报告中，我们改进了该设计，纳入来自不同来源的 β-glucans，设计了一个新的连接位点以将抗原共价连接至多糖骨架，并评估了这些新纳米颗粒处理 RAW264.7 肿瘤巨噬细胞后的细胞因子反应；我们发现它们可通过 TNF-a 和 IL-6 的基因表达诱发炎症性抗肿瘤反应。我们还设置了一个内置切割位点，使颗粒被 APCs 内吞后可由蛋白酶释放抗原。未来将这些构建体施用于动物，或可提供一种新的选择性方式，将肿瘤新抗原递送给免疫系统，作为不仅针对 PDACs、也针对任何其高表达肿瘤相关表面蛋白糖肽可被适应性免疫监视加工的癌症的治疗性疫苗。
items.author_line: John E. Chittum, Achyut Dahal, Joseph J. Barchi

items.title: Mapping Structured Absences in Scientific Papers: An Auditable LLM-Assisted Workflow Demonstrated on Cross-Coupling Chemistry
items.abstract_or_text: Scientific papers record what was discovered and communicated, but the resolution at which evidence relations are made explicit—a paper’s documentary resolution—often falls short of what later computational reuse, benchmarking, or data-driven synthesis requires. We present UQS (Unasked Question Structuring), an auditable LLM-assisted pipeline that takes scientific papers as input and produces structured absence records with evidence chains, an Evidence Pack (EP) dictionary specifying the evidence needed to reach the next evidential level, a bounded filling-status map across later literature under pre-locked criteria, and cross-paper research-question briefs. Applied to Kumada’s 1972 Ni-catalysed cross-coupling communication over a 54-year record window (1972–2026), UQS derives ten EPs and reveals a VQ-hierarchy inversion: methodology-level documentation is addressed early, whereas system-matched mechanistic documentation (VQ-3) appears only after 49 years (Mazet 2021), and quantitative-reliability documentation (VQ-4) remains a bounded non-detection—a pattern consistent with publication-incentive structure. The paper claims auditability, configuration-pinned rerun consistency, and internal robustness (four-model cross-comparison, N=6 multi-run aggregation); external expert validation is registered as future work.
items.summary_zh: 作者提出 UQS（Unasked Question Structuring）可审计 LLM 辅助流程，从论文中生成带证据链的结构化缺失记录、Evidence Pack 词典、后续文献填补状态图和跨论文研究问题简报，并用于回顾 Kumada 1972 年 Ni 催化交叉偶联之后 54 年的文献记录。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法把“未被充分报告的证据”转为可检查的数据对象，有助于催化机理、定量可靠性和数据再利用的系统审视；不过外部专家验证仍只是未来计划，结论基于单一历史案例及四模型、N=6 的内部稳健性测试。
items.abstract_zh: 科学论文记录了已发现和已交流的内容，但其中证据关系被明确表达的分辨率——即一篇论文的文献分辨率——往往低于后续计算复用、基准测试或数据驱动合成所需的水平。我们提出 UQS（Unasked Question Structuring），这是一个可审计的 LLM 辅助管线：以科学论文为输入，生成带有证据链的结构化缺失记录、规定达到下一证据层级所需证据的 Evidence Pack（EP）词典、在预先锁定标准下对后续文献进行限定的填补状态图，以及跨论文研究问题简报。应用于 Kumada 1972 年关于 Ni 催化交叉偶联的通信、覆盖 1972–2026 年的 54 年记录窗口时，UQS 导出十个 EP，并揭示 VQ 层级倒置：方法学层面的文档记录很早得到补充，而系统匹配的机理文档记录（VQ-3）直到 49 年后才出现（Mazet 2021），定量可靠性文档记录（VQ-4）仍是一项限定的未检出；这一模式与发表激励结构相一致。本文主张具有可审计性、配置锁定后的重运行一致性和内部稳健性（四模型交叉比较，N=6 多次运行汇总）；外部专家验证已登记为未来工作。
items.author_line: Yuriko Ono, Masaharu Yoshioka, Tetsuya Taketsugu

items.title: Coarse composition suffices: tabular in-context learning for multi-activity antimicrobial peptide profiling
items.abstract_or_text: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) often act against multiple pathogen classes, making multi-label activity prediction a more realistic screening target than binary antimicrobial classification. The ESCAPE benchmark formalizes this setting, but leading approaches typically rely on multimodal, structure-conditioned deep models that are costly to train and tune. We show that a simple, sequence-only pipeline can match and surpass these methods by combining 330 interpretable sequence descriptors with TabPFN, a tabular foundation model that performs in-context prediction in a single forward pass without gradient-based training or hyperparameter search. On ESCAPE (82,359 peptides; five labels), a label-powerset TabPFN model achieves mAP-5=77.8%, improving on the previously best reported 72.1%. A probabilistic classifier chain is the first method to match or exceed the best published average precision on each of the five labels simultaneously. The gains persist under the prior state-of-the-art single-fold training protocol, indicating they are not a training-set-size artefact, and are largest for remote homologues (+11.2 points below 30% sequence identity). Ablations further show that predicted structure is unnecessary at inference and that performance is not driven by any single descriptor family: ten global physicochemical scalars recover 91% of full-feature performance. Finally, explicitly modelling label dependence yields targeted benefits for scarce activities and supports ranking which activity to assay next from partial positive evidence.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 330 个可解释序列描述符和无需梯度训练或超参数搜索的 TabPFN，建立抗菌肽多活性预测流程；在含 82,359 条肽、五个标签的 ESCAPE 基准上，标签幂集模型达到 mAP-5=77.8%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 序列特征加表格基础模型在多标签抗菌肽筛选中超过复杂的结构条件模型，并在远缘同源肽上有显著收益，可用于安排后续活性测定；但证据来自计算基准，不能替代对预测肽的合成、活性和毒性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 抗菌肽（AMPs）通常对多类病原体发挥作用，因此多标签活性预测比二元抗菌分类更符合实际筛选目标。ESCAPE 基准将这一任务形式化，但领先方法通常依赖训练和调参成本高昂的多模态、结构条件深度模型。我们表明，一个简单的仅序列流程可通过结合 330 个可解释的序列描述符与 TabPFN 匹配并超越这些方法；TabPFN 是一种表格基础模型，可在单次前向传播中进行上下文预测，无需基于梯度的训练或超参数搜索。在 ESCAPE（82,359 条肽；五个标签）上，一个标签幂集 TabPFN 模型达到 mAP-5=77.8%，优于此前报道的最佳值 72.1%。概率分类器链是首个能在全部五个标签上同时达到或超过已发表最佳平均精度的方法。收益在此前最先进的单折训练方案下仍然存在，表明其并非训练集规模伪影；对于序列同一性低于 30% 的远缘同源物，收益最大（+11.2 个百分点）。消融研究进一步表明，推理时不需要预测结构，且性能并非由任何单一描述符家族驱动：十个全局理化标量即可恢复完整特征性能的 91%。最后，显式建模标签依赖性可为稀缺活性带来有针对性的收益，并支持根据部分阳性证据对下一项应检测的活性进行排序。
items.author_line: Kumar, R., Pal, A., Solanki, D., Pareek, P., Singh, J., Singla, J.

items.title: RPDynaFlow: Generating RNA-Protein Conformational Ensembles by Atomic Conditional Flow Matching
items.abstract_or_text: Conformation ensembles of biomolecules provide the basis for understanding structural transformations and drug design. Deep-learning generative models have advanced protein and small molecule ensemble generation, while RNA-Protein complexes remain unaddressed due to the chemical heterogeneity, limited dataset size and the different flexibility scales of RNA and protein components. We present RPDynaFlow, a flow-matching model to generate conformation ensembles of RNA-protein complexes, trained on 600 ns trajectories of molecular dynamics(MD) simulation. The results show our model extends the sampling range of the phase space compared to MD simulation, which couldbe treated as a rapid and efficient complement to MD trajectoriesfor studying RNA-protein interactions.
items.summary_zh: RPDynaFlow 采用原子级条件流匹配，基于 600 ns 分子动力学（MD）轨迹训练，以生成 RNA—蛋白质复合物构象集合，并报告其采样的相空间范围大于原始 MD 轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RNA—蛋白质复合物的构象异质性是理解结合和开展结构导向药物设计的重要难题，该方法尝试以生成模型加速探索；但训练数据来自有限时长 MD，摘要未提供实验结构或下游结合预测验证，扩展采样是否物理可信仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 生物分子的构象集合是理解结构转变和药物设计的基础。深度学习生成模型已推进蛋白质和小分子构象集合的生成，但由于化学异质性、数据集规模有限以及 RNA 和蛋白质组分的柔性尺度不同，RNA—蛋白质复合物仍未得到处理。我们提出 RPDynaFlow，这是一种用于生成 RNA—蛋白质复合物构象集合的流匹配模型，训练数据为 600 ns 的分子动力学（MD）模拟轨迹。结果表明，与 MD 模拟相比，我们的模型扩展了相空间的采样范围，可被视为研究 RNA—蛋白质相互作用时对 MD 轨迹的一种快速而高效的补充。

review.note: 共审阅 60 项候选，选出 8 项质量分不低于 70 且与 AI × Chem 直接相关的工作；其余高分候选因与化学研究关联不足或未呈现 AI 方法而未纳入。
